description: What UK acts typically get paid, from the GigXchange Index: median and range (25th-90th percentile) by city, gig type and act size, with sample size and an honest label when a figure is regional, UK-wide or modelled. Use for "what should my band charge", "what does a wedding band cost in Leeds", "cheapest city for pub gigs" (pass several cities to compare). Typical published artist take-home fees, not a quote. No genre dimension. Regions are not accepted - pass a city.

band_size.description: Act size. trio_quartet = "3-4 piece", five_plus = "5-piece or bigger". "any" (default) = all sizes.

cities.description: UK cities to look up (1-13), e.g. ["Leeds"] or several to compare. Omit for the UK-wide figure. get_index_summary lists the cities with their own data; other towns fall back to the nearest Index city (labelled).

use_case.description: Gig type. "any" (default) = all gig types. pubs_and_bars = pub/bar gigs. theatre exists for solo acts only.

name: get_rates
title: Typical live-music fees (GX Index)
